description: This file defines the SessionConfiguration class in Drupal, responsible for generating and managing session cookie settings based on HTTP requests, including handling secure cookies, cookie domain, and session naming conventions.

classes.name: SessionConfiguration
classes.description: Defines the default session configuration generator for Drupal, implementing session options and cookie handling logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes session options with defaults or provided settings.

methods.name: hasSession
methods.description: Checks if a session exists for the given request.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns session options, including cookie domain, secure flag, and name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Generates the session cookie name based on request security.

methods.name: getUnprefixedName
methods.description: Returns the session name without security prefix, using request host, base path, or cookie domain.

methods.name: getCookieDomain
methods.description: Determines the cookie domain, ensuring compatibility and security.

methods.name: drupalValidTestUa
methods.description: Wraps the drupal_valid_test_ua() function to validate user agent for testing.
